title: perf-canary: auto-detect latency/throughput regressions and rollout guards
author: Aisha Romero
release_notes: Add automated regression detection and rollout guard configuration for the perf-canary service. New config options for thresholding and sustained-regression windows. Automatic rollback and alerting on sustained regressions. Documentation and runbook included.
description:
Motivation: We observed manual intervention required when perf canaries detected regressions with noisy signals. This PR implements automatic detection of latency and throughput regressions, plus rollout guards that block or rollback model/service rollouts when sustained regressions are detected.

What changed: added an auto-detection pipeline that consumes perf metrics, computes relative regressions against the current baseline, and applies configurable thresholds plus a sustained-window check to reduce false positives. Added a rollout_guard module that can: block a rollout, trigger an automatic rollback, and create an alert with contextual perf diffs.

Highlights: config-driven thresholds (absolute and relative), configurable sustained window (minutes), jitter-tolerant detection to avoid transient spikes, and integration with existing perf-canary dashboard and alerting plumbing. The detection logic supports both latency P95/P99 and throughput percentiles.

Files/areas touched: perf-canary service (auto-detect pipeline), config templates (helm/chart configmap), console UI for canary configuration, unit/integration tests, and documentation/runbook.

Testing: unit tests added for detection logic and for rollout guard decision paths. Integration tests simulate small regressions and sustained regressions to validate blocking/rollback behavior. Perf regression job added to CI to validate no regressions on baseline.

Rollout plan: feature flags gated behind perf-canary.v2.enabled; start with 10% of canaries in staging, evaluate alerts for one week, then flip default for production. Runbook included for manual override and to handle noisy environments.

Related: ENG-1423 (perf-canary improvements), SRE-517 (on-call runbook updates).
